sheets.title: Security as a guest — desktop
sheets.caption: Every key on the page acts. The disabled Vault key protection keys, the policy sentences, the locked Email and Text rows and the locked Recovery row are gone: each was a control a guest could not use.
sheets.before: Vault key protection drawn with 2 disabled keys and 3 policy lines; Email and Text rows locked with a gear that led to a Host form; a locked Recovery row
sheets.after: Unlock methods, Second step (authenticator only, until a key exists), Formats, Age keys, Transport — no disabled key, no lock standing for not-yet

sheets.title: Formats, Age keys, Transport as a guest — desktop
sheets.caption: Formats lists what can be done (SOPS document, age armor) instead of a Read/Write/Runtime table of what is supported. Transport is unchanged: its idle rows are an ADR 0132 acceptance scenario.
sheets.before: A four-row support matrix with locked GPG marks
sheets.after: Two action rows; Transport as before

sheets.title: Security as a guest — phone
sheets.caption: The same list at 390 wide.
sheets.before: Eight panels, most of their keys disabled or leading away
sheets.after: Panels that each have something to press

sheets.title: Security with a personal vault — desktop
sheets.caption: With a vault sealed, Vault key protection appears with keys that work: Preferred and Remove on the password row, Add and Rotate in its head. Test is offered only where the service can prove a protector (a recovery key), and an enrolled recovery key now shows in the list.
sheets.before: Static policy list, an inert status row, rows whose keys failed with 'Protector … is not enrolled', an added recovery key that never appeared
sheets.after: Rows that read the sealed manifest; Add, Preferred, Remove, Rotate all work
